intro.label: Institution
intro.text: Halbton is a centre for the printed image in a former offset printing plant in Berlin-Wedding. Every image shown, silver, digital or generated, passes through the same screen.

media.alt: Press hall on the ground floor, the offset press between paper stacks and the windows on the Panke side.

archive.label: Archive
archive.intro: Proofs, screen tests, stray sheets and press views, kept in date order, outside the exhibition programme.

about.title: [About]
paragraphs: Former offset printing plant on the Panke, Wedding. One working press downstairs, two exhibition floors, reading room under the sawtooth roof. Same screen for every image shown; same paper for every edition.
Each exhibition, eight to twelve a year, ends in an edition printed on the press. The edition enters the collection; working proofs and tests are logged in the archive.
